host.measurement_method: PowerShell Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem / Win32_OperatingSystem and Get-PSDrive C, one sample while other applications were running

limits.output_estimation_method: measured: the largest retained run so far (full-chip simulation with logs) is below 20 MB; a build folder is 87 MB; 128 MB per run is the conservative bound
limits.revision_note: 2026-11-21: stop threshold lowered from 4 GiB to 2 GiB because the host had 4.2 GiB free and the 5 GiB scratch build tree of the old verification folder was not deleted without approval

waveform_policy.planned_signal_scope: none for passing runs; PHY, APB and AXI interface pins for a failure rerun
waveform_policy.planned_time_windows: the failing transaction and 2000 CLK-PHY cycles before it
